answer: Reusing one run across aliases collides on the thread identifier and voids the later submissions, which means the operator forfeits for 324 runs and collects one. Because the voyage index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the vine audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 324 answers need 324 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
